html_content:
Our Store

Your one-stop shop for instruments, accessories, books, and more

Instruments

Our store carries a wide selection of instruments for musicians of all levels, from beginners to professionals. Whether you're picking up your first guitar or upgrading to a professional-grade kit, we have what you need.

Guitars

We stock an impressive range of guitars to suit every style and budget:

  • Classical Guitars — Perfect for classical repertoire, flamenco, and beginners. Nylon-string instruments from trusted brands offering warm, rich tone.
  • Electric Guitars — From solid-body to semi-hollow, we carry guitars suited for rock, blues, jazz, and everything in between.
  • Bass Guitars — 4-string, 5-string, and fretless models for every genre and playing style.

Drums & Percussion

Complete drum kits, individual shells, cymbals, hardware, and percussion instruments. We carry acoustic and electronic drum sets for practice and performance.

Keyboards & Pianos

Digital pianos, synthesizers, MIDI controllers, and portable keyboards. Ideal for home practice, stage performance, and studio production.

Amplifiers

Guitar amps, bass amps, and keyboard amplifiers in a range of sizes and power ratings. From practice amps for your bedroom to stage-ready combos and heads.

Books & Manuals

We stock an extensive selection of music books and instructional manuals covering all instruments and skill levels. Our collection includes:

  • Method books for guitar, piano, drums, bass, voice, violin, and more
  • Music theory textbooks from beginner to advanced
  • Sheet music collections and songbooks across all genres
  • Sight-reading and ear-training workbooks
  • Exam preparation books for RCM and other conservatory programs

Can't find what you're looking for? We can special-order any title with fast delivery.

Instrument Rentals

Not ready to buy? Our rental program lets you try an instrument before committing to a purchase. Rentals are available for most instruments and are ideal for students just starting out or for those who want to explore a new instrument. Rental fees can be applied toward a future purchase.

Repairs & Maintenance

Our experienced technicians provide professional instrument repair and maintenance services, including:

  • Guitar setups, restringing, and fret work
  • Drum head replacement and hardware repair
  • Keyboard and electronics troubleshooting
  • General instrument cleaning and maintenance

Bring your instrument in for a free assessment and quote.

Visit Us

Come browse our store in person at our Pointe-Claire location. Our knowledgeable staff are happy to help you find the right instrument, book, or accessory for your needs.

Contact Us
